name: Foshan Blue Rocket Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Foshan Blue Rocket Electronics Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor devices in the People's Republic of China. It offers bridge rectifier; rectifier, transient voltage suppression, ESD protection, zener, fast recovery, Schottky, and switch diodes; mosfets; digital transistors; silicon controlled rectifiers; insulated gate bipolar transistor; and low dropout linear and three-terminal regulator. The company also provides EEROM, charging management IC, AC/DC, operational amplifier, LED driver IC, and lithium battery protection.
